import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { EMPTY_STRING, FIRST_ARG_INDEX, MIN_SKILL_BOOK_ID } from '@src/constants';
import { toggleSkillBookHidden } from '@src/response-apps/skillBook/hidden/toggle';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

const response = onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;

  const messageText = (e.MessageText || EMPTY_STRING).replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?显示功法\s*/, EMPTY_STRING).trim();
  const args = messageText ? messageText.split(/\s+/) : [];
  const skillBookId = Number.parseInt(args[FIRST_ARG_INDEX] ?? EMPTY_STRING, 10);
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (!Number.isInteger(skillBookId) || skillBookId < MIN_SKILL_BOOK_ID) {
    md.addText('❌ 参数错误');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('使用方法: /显示功法 功法ID');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const result = await toggleSkillBookHidden({ request: createBackendRequestContext(e), bid, uid, skillBookId, isHidden: false });

  md.addText(result.code === 'OK' ? `✅ ${result.data.message}` : `❌ ${result.data.message}`);

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '',
      content: md,
      footer: [
        { label: '我的隐藏功法', command: '/我的隐藏功法' },
        { label: '我的功法', command: '/我的功法' }
      ]
    })
  );
});

export default response;
